inputs.text: The news out of Cuba makes it clear we're looking at a political shakeup that will only sharpen the massive divides between the wealthy and the rest of society. Everyday people on the island lack the resources to step in and claim any role in running businesses during this shift, which shuts them out completely. Instead, the wealthy diaspora and foreign investors are lined up to grab property and assets for next to nothing. This isn't a fair or neutral process—it's a mechanism that hands more power to the privileged elite, pushing vulnerable workers and communities deeper into the margins while locking in structural exploitation. Those who've already been left behind for generations won't see any real gains from this. What we need instead are genuine reforms that put labor rights first and defend the most disadvantaged against another cycle of dispossession.
